function: Massive MIMO symbol detection: a purely data-driven, permutation-equivariant network (ChannelNet) recovers the transmitted QAM symbols from the received signal and the channel matrix (p. 2, p. 4).
system: Uplink massive MIMO, (Nr,Nt) = (64,32) and (128,64), single-antenna users, frequency-flat, 16/64-QAM; 3.5 GHz in the 3GPP case; no RIS (p. 2, p. 8, p. 9).
method: ChannelNet-MLP and -Conv: iterative antenna-feature processors with channel-embedded linear layers; supervised cross-entropy training with Adam, 600 epochs of 2e6 samples (p. 4, p. 6, p. 8).
data_channel: Simulated Rayleigh i.i.d.; Kronecker with exponential correlation 0.6; 3GPP 3D-UMa-NLOS from QuaDRiGa at 3.5 GHz; all simulated (p. 8, p. 9).
test_conditions: Trained and tested on the same distribution; also trained on 3D-UMa-NLOS and tested on 3D-UMi-NLOS, with CSI error (SNR_H 15/20 dB) and non-Gaussian noise (p. 8, p. 10).
baselines: Non-learned: MMSE, AMP, V-BLAST, ML (Gurobi). Learned: DetNet, OAMPNet, AMP-GNN, RE-MIMO (p. 7, p. 8).
metrics: Symbol error rate versus SNR; number of multiplications; inference and training time per batch of 256 samples (p. 7, p. 11, p. 12).
complexity: O(Nt Nr); multiplications L(dNK+2d^2K+2d^2N); Table I counts, e.g. 0.98e7 at (64,32); inference 0.88 ms and training 2.35 ms per batch (p. 11, p. 12).
openness: none for ChannelNet; only the official repositories of the baselines DetNet, OAMPNet, AMP-GNN and RE-MIMO are used (p. 7, p. 8).
q1_support: p. 9: "under the 3GPP 3D MIMO channel model [51] simulated using the QuaDRiGa channel simulator [52]"; p. 8 says training and testing samples come from the same distribution.
q2_support: p. 10: "train all detectors using channels from the “3D-UMa-NLOS” scenario, but test them with channels from the “3D-UMi-NLOS” scenario"
q3_support: p. 8: "ChannelNet-MLP consistently matches or outperforms other detectors"; SER is compared with non-learned MMSE, AMP, V-BLAST, ML (p. 7) and learned DetNet, OAMPNet, AMP-GNN, RE-MIMO (p. 7, p. 8).
q4_support: p. 11: "the asymptotic computational complexity for both ChannelNet-MLP and ChannelNet-Conv can be expressed as O(N K)"; Table I (p. 12) lists multiplications and times.
q5_support: p. 7: "We use the official repository at https://github.com/neevsamuel/"; these repositories are baselines only. No link for the code or data of ChannelNet, and the channels are simulated (p. 8, p. 9).
notes: Area 1: the learned detector recovers symbols and the metric is the SER. q1 rests on the QuaDRiGa 3D-UMa-NLOS channels (p. 9); the 3GPP reference [51] on p. 14 is TR 36.873, the 3D LTE channel model, so the reviewer should confirm. Rayleigh and Kronecker sets are custom. q2 counts only the UMa to UMi shift (p. 10); CSI error and non-Gaussian noise tests are not counted.
